reuse.why: Adds one guard used by all five provider link functions and uses the existing db.first query helper and APIError; it does not take the chance to route the copied link bodies through the existing finishLinkingAccount, but that was not needed for the rule.

duplication.why: The rule is written once in ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked; each provider adds only a call with its provider name.

placement.why: The guard sits next to the link helpers in accounts/app.ts and runs before findOrCreateBank so nothing is created on refusal, which is why it cannot live in finishLinkingAccount.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls and tests for it.

maintainability.why: Simple, readable helper; a future provider must remember to call it since the five link bodies are still separate copies.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing abstraction is bypassed; every link path calls the new guard.

one_place.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
